description: This file contains implementations of memory duplication and allocation functions such as Curl_strdup, Curl_wcsdup, Curl_memdup, Curl_memdup0, and Curl_saferealloc used within the curl project. It includes platform-specific code and utility functions for safe memory handling.

methods.name: char * Curl_strdup(const char * str)
methods.description: Duplicates a string using malloc, returning NULL if input is NULL or memory allocation fails.

methods.name: wchar_t * Curl_wcsdup(const wchar_t * src)
methods.description: Duplicates a wide-character string, allocating new memory and returning NULL on failure or overflow.

methods.name: void * Curl_memdup(const void * src,size_t length)
methods.description: Duplicates memory data of specified length, with safe handling of malloc failure.

methods.name: void * Curl_memdup0(const char * src,size_t length)
methods.description: Duplicates memory data of specified length, null-terminates the result, with safe malloc handling.

methods.name: void * Curl_saferealloc(void * ptr,size_t size)
methods.description: Reallocates memory, freeing the original pointer if reallocation fails or size is zero.
